## Tools used

- [Google Colab](https://colab.research.google.com/): the original project was done fully on Colab and still uses it to showcase the results
- [RoyaleAPI](https://royaleapi.com/): used their proxy service of the official Clash Royale API
- [Quarto](https://quarto.org/): for writing the notebooks and the website

## Inspiration related references

The inspiration for making this analysis came after watching the video [Clash Royale is a Disgrace to Mobile Gaming by bananadev](https://youtu.be/qlQdZ-H_EWY?si=jGeCpGEaMsh7KCVr) and more specifically a friend of mine showed me [Jynxzi's reaction to it](https://youtu.be/8OpOByZBR94?si=mnsBVDqldAAJgQEf)

Huge shoutout to NovaLightCR for making the [original post](https://www.reddit.com/r/ClashRoyale/comments/m2jl0c/effort_post_what_an_analysis_of_688k_battles/) cited in the video. This project is completely indipendent from his but we are running a very similar analysis both in goal and methods.
